statements.text: Smt. P. Sandhya Rani's request for transfer to Regional Office, Rajahmundry on spouse grounds was approved on 27/05/2025.
Sri K. Venkata Ramana's request for transfer to Regional Office, Kurnool on spouse grounds was not considered on 30/05/2025 in view of a pending enquiry.
statements.quote: Not considered in view of the pending enquiry.
